subject.title: feat: add Computer Use plugin manifest contract

question: Should OpenClaw accept `contracts.computerUseProviders` and `computerUseProviderMetadata` as the public metadata-only plugin manifest contract for macOS Computer Use discovery with these field names and permission semantics?
rationale: The patch is additive, but the fields become plugin API surface and are intended to inform host binding around Accessibility and Screen Recording permissions, so automation cannot choose the permanent contract or trust boundary.

options.title: Adopt after rebase, docs map, and owner confirmation
options.body: Use this branch or the rebased candidate, refresh generated docs, and merge only after owners confirm metadata remains discovery-only.

options.title: Revise the contract shape first
options.body: Change field names, platform shape, permission enum, or MCP metadata before publishing the plugin manifest surface.

options.title: Pause for host design alignment
options.body: Keep both draft PRs open or close one manually until the macOS host discovery and trust boundary are settled.

recommendation.title: Adopt after rebase, docs map, and owner confirmation
recommendation.body: Use this branch or the rebased candidate, refresh generated docs, and merge only after owners confirm metadata remains discovery-only.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest recent history on plugin manifest metadata/docs and opened the rebased candidate PR that appears intended to carry this contract forward.
